$comment: Read from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFCC (AIP France, chart dated 2026-10-01): the reporting points come from the coordinates table of the chart,
the notes from the English column of its text pages, both read by a script and checked (each point lies within 80 NM of the aerodrome).
Only what the chart prints is recorded; nothing is deduced. Services, frequencies, elevation, position, magnetic variation and runways
were first extracted automatically from the chart text. Drawings (circuit, routes, radials) are not read.
The charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.

A "fr" object holds the French column of the same chart, copied as printed and never translated: a French note sits at the index of its English twin and is left empty when the twin could not be paired with certainty; the French of the procedures and of the points' purposes is not recorded.
name: Cahors - Lalbenque

source.extraction: chart text, table and English column read by script, checked
source.frenchExtraction: French column of the chart text, read by script and paired with the English sentences

service.atsHours: AFIS : LUN-VEN / MON-FRI : 0815-1100, 1300-1700. En dehors de ces HOR O/R AFIS pour vols IFR / Outside these SKED, O/R AFIS for IFR only. SAM, DIM et JF : assuré uniquement au profit des vols IFR avec PPR le jour ouvrable précédent avant 1600. SAT, SUN and HOL : possible only for IFR flights on PPR before 1600 on the previous working day. Aérodrome de CAHORS - 46230 CIEURAC (UTC HIV ; HOR ETE : -1HR)

preferredQfuReason: preferred QFU 307, while RWY 13 is in use (in this configuration, priority is given to the traffic using the RWY in use)
notes: Possible IFR operations.
Night use prohibited.
AD reserved for radio-equipped ACFT.
Simultaneous use of both RWY prohibited.

In certain weather conditions, couplings ACFT-glider of Lotois Gliding Center may have to take-off from preferred QFU 307° while RWY 13 is in use (in this configuration, priority is given to the traffic using the RWY in use).
Domed runway: caution is advised before entering RWY due to lack of visibility along RWY.
Sloping apron: wheel chocks recommended.
TKOF and LDG of ACFT prohibited if an ACFT is immobilized on the unpaved RWY.
When parking aircraft, take care not to obstruct access to the pelicandrome.
Prefer parking facing the runway, with your back to the PJE (NR 391) on AD, FL 140, SR - SS+30.
Above FL 115, real activity known on TOULOUSE APP.
Below FL 115: real activity known by CLERMONT APP and by CAHORS A/A.
PJE ACFT circuit SW of AD.
Activité IFR possible.
Utilisation de nuit interdite.
AD réservé aux ACFT munis de radio.
Utilisation simultanée des deux pistes interdite.

Dans certaines conditions météorologiques, les attelages avions-planeurs du Centre de Vol à Voile Lotois peuvent être amenés à décoller depuis le QFU 307° alors que la piste 13 est en service (lors de cette configuration, les trafics utilisant la piste en service restent prioritaires).
Piste bombée : prudence recommandée avant de pénétrer sur la piste à cause de l'absence de visibilité.
PRKG en pente : cales recommandées.
Tout TKOF ou LDG d'ACFT est suspendu si un ACFT est immobilisé sur la piste non revêtue.
Lors du stationnement, attention à ne pas bloquer l'accès au pélicandrome.
Au-dessus FL 115, activité réelle connue de TOULOUSE APP.
En dessous du FL 115 : activité réelle connue de CLERMONT APP et de CAHORS A/A.
Circuit ACFT largueurs parachutistes au SW.
